next.reason: 1985: "The INVALID KEY phrase must be specified for a DELETE statement which references a file which is not in sequential access mode"; 2023: "depends on the presence or absence of the optional INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY phrases (GR-14.9.10.4-11); no rule requires them". 2023 makes INVALID KEY optional and drops the 1985 rule requiring it for non-sequential access without a USE procedure; SR-14.9.10.3-2 only forbids it in sequential mode.
